== Biography ==
John Glasgow was born about 1790 in Scotland. He served in the British Army and later received a pension as a Chelsea Pensioner. By trade he was a weaver, working in Kilmarnock, Ayrshire.

He married [[Gemmill-363|Janet Gemmill]] on 6 March 1829 in Kilmarnock.<ref>"Scotland, Select Marriages, 1561–1910," Ancestry (accessed 17 Nov 2021). John Glasgow marriage to Janet Gemmill on 6 Mar 1829, Kilmarnock, Ayrshire.</ref> They raised their family in Kilmarnock where John balanced weaving with his pension income.

By the 1851 census the family lived in Mitchell’s Land, Kilmarnock, where John was head of household, age 60, recorded as a weaver and Chelsea Pensioner.<ref>"1851 Scotland Census," Parish: Kilmarnock, ED: 4, Page: 11, Roll: CSSCT1851_133. Ancestry (accessed 17 Nov 2021).</ref> Their household included wife Janet (55), son [[Glasgow-1579|John]] (21), daughter [[Glasgow-1580|Isabella]] (20), daughter [[Glasgow-1581|Janet]] (11), and [[Glasgow-1582|Margaret]] (10). A 45-year-old [[Glasgow-1577|Alexander Glasgow]] was also present, likely an elder son or relative.



== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3298]] is assessed at 98% (proved). The retained Kilmarnock child citation places John, born24 January and christened27 January 1791, in John Glasgow and Margaret Wyllie’s family. John-3298 represents this particular couple, married in 1788 with an ordered local child sequence, strongly identifying the recorded father.

Recorded 1791 child and Wyllie household; the older John’s 1755 childhood and the child’s later soldier/pensioner identity remain separate.

Next useful test: Check the 1791 original and the child-to-pensioner continuity.

Source basis already held: [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XTVR-Q89 Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950, entry for John Glasgow, 27 Jan 1791; FamilySearch (accessed 21 Sep 2025) ARK:XTVR-Q89 (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XTVR-Q89).]. No new original inspected; no new father attached.



* Some researchers note a possible earlier marriage to Janet Jackson in January 1825 at New Monkland, Lanarkshire, but this may represent a different John Glasgow.<ref>"Scotland, Select Marriages, 1561–1910," Ancestry (accessed 17 Nov 2021).</ref>
* Do not confuse this profile with [[Glasgow-427|John Glasgow (bef.1790–1856)]] of New Monkland who married Marion Anderson in 1810.
